notes: «ورواه معمر عن أيوب» and «ورواه بكار بن عبد العزيز عن أبيه عن أبي بكرة» name different transmitters for the same saying, so they are variant groups (rule 4).
The variant groups are written as the text states them, so they end at the names it gives; the Hasan-Ahnaf-Abu Bakra tail is not repeated for them.
The Prophet is the end of the chain, not a link.
